user_reviews.Name: Oumy Samb
user_reviews.Description:
Franchement, c’est à se demander si cette boulangerie respecte encore ses clients. Chaque jour — matin, midi, soir — le même scénario : les baguettes à 150 F ne sont jamais disponibles, “pas encore sorties du four”, “il faut attendre”. Par contre, les baguettes à 200 F et plus, elles, sont toujours prêtes, bien rangées, comme par hasard.

On finit par comprendre le manège : pousser les gens à acheter les plus chères. C’est honteux et injuste, surtout pour les clients fidèles qui viennent tous les jours. Ce n’est pas du commerce honnête, c’est de la manipulation.

Et pour ne rien arranger, le personnel est souvent impoli, hautain, et semble dérangé dès qu’on pose une simple question. Aucune politesse, aucun sourire — on a presque l’impression de les déranger en venant acheter du pain !

C’est dommage, car la qualité du pain n’est pas mauvaise, mais le comportement et la politique de vente laissent vraiment à désirer. J’espère que la direction prendra conscience de cette mauvaise pratique, parce qu’à force, vous risquez de perdre la confiance de toute une clientèle.

La tarte aux pommes est trop simple (pâte brisée compote de pommes et de fines lamelles de pommes) un peu sucrée à mon goût. Enfin le cookie est généreusement garni de pépites de chocolat, crousti-moelleux comme j'aime je l'aurai préféré un poil moins sucré.

user_reviews.Name: Zeïnab Ba
user_reviews.Description: Je commande chez Bakery & Sweets depuis 2019 a raison d’au moins 3 gâteaux d’anniversaire (layer cakes,…) par an. Je commandais souvent à distance étant à l’étranger, les gâteaux étaient livrés sans problème. J’étais toujours été satisfaite même quand il y a eu un accident avec une livraison de cupcakes pour un mariage en 2021 - on m’a renvoyé le lendemain une boîte. Le service a l’époque était impeccable. J’ai toujours commandé même quand le service de livraison à été arrêté. Pour le 21 avril, j’ai commandé un layer cake pour 20 personnes pour 14h pour la fête d’anniversaire de ma petite nièce. Exceptionnellement, je m’y suis prise un peu tard (on m’a répondu aussi tard) mais malgré tout on m’a assuré que c’était bon. Le dimanche 21 avril à 14 heures, étant dans le quartier de la pâtisserie, je les appelle. Le gâteau n’était pas prêt…. On me promet qu’il sera prêt la demi-heure d’après….. Je rappelle. On me répond que le pâtissier est en train de finaliser, de venir. J’arrive à 14h47. Le gâteau n’est ni emballé même pas sorti de la cuisine. La fête d’anniversaire a commencé, je suis attendue et dois libérer la voiture. On me lance des plates excuses. Si ce n’était que le retard…. Dans la voiture, au bout de dix minutes de trajet, le gâteau commence à s’effondrer. Forcément il a été fait à la va-vite. Résultat des courses, arrivée à la maison, le gâteau ne ressemblait à rien. Heureusement, il y avait un autre gâteau pour souffler les bougies. Je l’ai signalé et jusqu’au jour d’aujourd’hui je n’ai pas eu de réponse. En résumé, je ne recommande pas Bakery & Sweets pour le manque de professionnalisme et la qualité de service qui s’est beaucoup détériorée pour un prix qui ne se justifie pas dans ce cas. À cela se rajoute le manque de considération et cela après tant d’années. Bref, le goumin est lourd et amer.

user_reviews.Name: Grace
user_reviews.Description: This is the first restaurant I’ve been to where management becomes confused when you tell them food and coffee should not be served cold. I was extremely kind but the manager spoke to me in a condescending tone as if I was a child. I don’t think being patronizing is OK in such an environment. I understand you are busy, but if my request is simple, it really should not be an issue and this is really the first time that this has happened where cold food is served and there is a refusal to reheat it. But alas the food including the eggs and coffee came out cold and I told the staff before ordering that everything needs to be cooked well because I have a condition that could hospitalize me if the food isn’t well cooked. They served me cold tomatoes at were indeed cooked but I explained that they needed to be hot so that I can make sure they were safe for me to eat. But the coffee was only luke warm and when I asked them to cook it again, the manager became very defensive and argumentative and then told me I had to pay for the meal even if I didnt eat it. Once the lady manager stopped being condescending and actually listened to me, they took the food and coffee and returned both of them hot and it was OK. But this whole scenario could have been avoided if the manager was just a little professional and not so combative. It really was a very simple problem with a very simple solution I’m not sure why it was so difficult for the manager.  This lack of professionalism from management was shocking but I hope it will be a learning experience for them. When presented with a problem, find a solution. Dont blame your guest and escalate the issue. Otherwise the young lady who was serving us was very nice and professional.

user_reviews.Description:
I love this place!

Great coffee and hot drinks, cozy ambiance, and consistently friendly service.

It’s the perfect spot to work, relax, or catch up with friends. Always a pleasure coming here.

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
The portions are generous, and some dishes really offer great value.

The burger is my top pick: juicy, flavorful, with delicious homemade chips. The Caesar salad is also great , and the salmon poke was okay but a bit lacking in flavor. The macchiato is always a reliable pick me up and the freshly squeezed orange juice is a great brunch add-on.

I did try the American breakfast once and didn’t enjoy it—it felt underwhelming compared to the rest of the menu but it’s not a reason to not come back.

Service is prompt, friendly and helpful. The ambiance is gorgeous and the place is very popular which is a great sign! Definitely recommended

user_reviews.Name: Tariro Mlanda
user_reviews.Description: Loved the food here. The taste, the presentation, the huge portion sizes. Some meals actually come with drinks so be sure to check before you purchase drinks on the side. The service was also on point and our waiter could speak English as well so made ordering easy. Awesome place to have breakfast and brunch. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: B. Aidara
user_reviews.Description:
This cafe is a short walk to/from the U.S. Embassy, a grocery store and the sea. The cafe is comfortable and intimate. However it does not strike me as a cafe where you could work and study. I didn’t see outlets or tables appropriate for working on a computer or writing.
I ordered a snack - a slice of pineapple cake and a cup of cappuccino. The cake was dry. In fact, the texture of the cask was thick like bread. I did not enjoy this item. It cost 2 thousand cifa. I do not recommend the dry (or stale) pineapple cake/bread. The cappuccino was decent. I prefer dark roast coffee with body ody ody, but this coffee was bland and without nuance. Nevertheless it served its purpose by washing down the dry cake/bread.
The customer service was relatively good. Meaning the employees seemed to work well together and they were kind to customers. However they should not have served that dry cake.
I will neither return nor recommend this venue, but if you are jonsing for a cup of coffee and anything will do, then go to Kotao Coffee.

user_reviews.Name: Mariel Camargo
user_reviews.Description: Delicious and refreshing smoothie 😍 the entire space is outside but it is well shaded so it doesn’t get too hot. There’s also fans going around so it brings the heat down. Good space to work as well!

user_reviews.Name: peter casey
user_reviews.Description: Be very careful 🧐 if you are a tourist. X3 people had a drink & a burger 🍔 each. The bill came to like £20. I paid with my card & wasn't observant. When I checked my account they had debited £60.

user_reviews.Name: A
user_reviews.Description: Good coffees, juices, bowls and cakes. I wish they had more vegetarian options. Minus two stars since I had food poisoning after eating their fish and chips and on a separate occasion a friend also got food poisoning after the same fish and chips dish. Maybe don’t serve fish if the chefs can’t tell when the fish is bad.

user_reviews.Description: Very calming and relaxing atmosphere, lovely food and drinks, nice place to relax, do work and or read to pass some time. Highly recommend. Thank you

user_reviews.Description: Great place to gather the latest scuttlebutt as well as enjoying perfectly roasted coffee beans seasoned with great conversion and friendly interactions with both staff and patrons. The panini sandwiches are delicious and filling and atmosphere relaxed enough to ensure a fantastic beginning of the day if you come in for breakfast

user_reviews.Name: Waly DIOUF
user_reviews.Description: A great place, if not the best in Dakar, for focus working, learning or just chilling… I’ve experienced teamwork and meetings in two Layu places and it went so smoothly and well that you feel like you are in a company meeting room (but more cozy) or a library. Keep it in mind next time you want some “me time” to work on a project (by yourself or with a team) or just to focus learn. I luv it every single time.

user_reviews.Name: Christina Tochukwu Ngene
user_reviews.Description: I was wowed to see the set up in Layu cafe. You can just walk in, get a cup of coffee and work from in there. I was more impressed to see so many books inside the cafe, bought one instantly and sat there to read. The space in Layu is just the best. It's has all these nice corners for privacy and it's big!

user_reviews.Name: Magnus Ohman
user_reviews.Description: Great atmosphere and juices (recommend the mango and mint smoothie). My sandwich was good rather than great though.

user_reviews.Description: The food is not bad although it can be abit greasy and pricey but the service is an absolute put-off. I’ve ordered there several times and usually it takes a while, but today I had to call back after 40 minutes and was told my order was out of stock, so I ended up having to delay my lunch by one hour and order elsewhere. I suspect they simply forgot to put in my order and had ran out of food by the time I called to check. It’s a shame the service is so poor for what would be otherwise an acceptable restaurant, although not the healthiest and a bit overpriced.

user_reviews.Description: This is a delightful yet expensive cafe in les Almadies. I found everything I ate to be delicious, and the coffees were quite good as well. I had the feeling that I could stay and visit with my friends for a while and no one was rushing me out. The ambiance and atmosphere was very charming. I was surprised to see wine for sale with the Noliane label; the staff told me they import it from Italy. For Senegal, that was a surprise for me!

user_reviews.Name: C Neon
user_reviews.Description: This is a beautiful Italian restaurant in Dakar.  It is inside a nice hotel with a wine bar.   The chef is from Italy and the dishes were very good as he uses a lot of ingredients from Italy.   The staff is well trained and the atmosphere is very contemporary and relaxing.   A good experience.

user_reviews.Name: Yagazie Emezi
user_reviews.Description: Cute cafe. We sat inside, the bar area is pretty. Ordered a salad and pizza. Both delicious. The main star was their special spicy oil, a must try with your pizza! Ended up buying a bottle of it because it was that good and it’s now like liquid gold in my home. Overall, add this to your list of solid breakfast joints to check out while in Dakar. Super fresh orange juice too.

user_reviews.Name: Jean and Martin Choi
user_reviews.Description: This is probably one of the better restaurants in Dakar. The food is absolutely delicious and well flavored. We love their salads and pasta and most definitely their tiramisu. The environment is lovely. There is an English tea setting inside and a nice little outdoor alcove. The price is a bit on the expensive side, but you do receive the quality of food and ingredients.

user_reviews.Name: diallo karim
user_reviews.Description:
Super nice restaurant. The food is delicious and the menu simple.
The staff will great you and serve you well.

user_reviews.Name: Chop Stay Love
user_reviews.Description:
Caffe Noliane serves up the best pizza I’ve tasted so far in Dakar. The base is thin, crispy, cheesy—just how I like it. Full of flavour and super satisfying.

My only complaint? I wish it was bigger!

Great little spot if you’re craving proper pizza done right.

user_reviews.Name: SANTIAGUE DEPREZ
user_reviews.Description: This is one of my favorite spots in Dakar. The seafood pizza is really the best thing ever. The steak is mouth watering and the burgers are juicy and tasty. What more can I say? The vibe is great indoors or outdoors there are beautiful birds all around the courtyard and the staff is great especially the security guards that greet you at the entrance, always a warm smile and ready to accommodate of needed. The drinks are also amazing and strong! I will eat here every chance I get to visit Dakar!

user_reviews.Name: Tifani Dyson
user_reviews.Description: I meant to take a picture before I ate, but it was just too good. Came here twice this week. The first time I was underwhelmed by the burger, but on the second visit the pizza was AHHmazing. I played it safe with margarita pizza, but the seafood one looks good as well. And I can’t forget the spicy oil that they leave for the table. So good, I wish I could buy some.

user_reviews.Name: Malina D
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely loved ILEA Cafe!! The owners were kind enough to host my university program in for a welcoming event at the cafe as we traveled to Senegal, and we had the most amazing brunch and drinks.

The owners were kind and welcoming to us during our time in Dakar. They took time out of their busy schedules to talk to each of the students and professor in our program to ensure we were having the best time during our travels in Senegal. It’s truly inspiring to see how far this business has come, and I’m excited to see their success thrive in the future.

I highly recommend for everyone to stop by this lovely cafe! 💞

user_reviews.Name: Agina Briggs
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely loved this cafe! The ambiance is beautiful and cozy, with such a warm, inviting vibe. The menu is thoughtful and creative, there is something for everybody honestly! Everything tasted fresh and well-made, my favorite was the chicken taco burrito and the cookies! The staff was welcoming and attentive, and the presentation of the food was just as good as the flavors. (I love a good presentation honey) It’s the perfect spot for brunch, dessert, or just a coffee moment. Highly recommend and I will definitely be back!

user_reviews.Name: Tracy BD
user_reviews.Description:
My family had such a wonderful time at Ilea Café. The food was excellent across the board,
the yassa poulet was flavorful and tender, the fish fatayas were perfectly crisp and delicious, and we really enjoyed the coffees and cookies to finish things off.

As good as the food was, what really stood out was the hospitality. The owners went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, and their warmth made the whole experience even more special. It felt less like dining out and more like being hosted by friends who genuinely care.

Ilea Café is the kind of place you want to return to, not just for the food but for the atmosphere and the people behind it. Highly recommended if you’re in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: Dhani-Sinaan
user_reviews.Description: Ilea café is THE BEST restaurant in Sénégal!!!! The staff is so warm and welcoming—feels like family. But the food is out of this world and they JUST expanded their menu to include VEGAN OPTIONS!!!! Omg My favorite was their magical Chai Latte, the “In love with the Coco” Smoothie, their Vegan Riz Cantonais, their Vegan Taco Burrito, Vegan Wrap, and their Vegan Oreo Milkshake. I also loved their giant green super salad as it was so hearty, refreshing and nourishing. I think this is the first time I almost couldn’t finish a salad—it was that filling!!!  I will be coming back again, again and again. Jërëjëf  Ilea Café!!!!

user_reviews.Name: Caasi
user_reviews.Description:
I had the pleasure of eating here with my study abroad program and it was such a fun time! ILEA had custom menus with my school’s name which contributed to the warm welcome. I enjoyed the Oh My Gaufre Brunch with a Mango Matcha with Oat Milk. The brunch was so good and was similar to my comfort food of Chicken & Waffles back at home.

I was also able to meet the owners who welcomed my program and have such an enriching conversation about life transitions, professional development, and family. After the lunch and discussion, my program and I stayed at the cafe to watch Senegal win the semifinals. The experience celebrating such a win at ILEA Cafe will be unforgettable. Thank you Ilea Cafe for your welcome & hospitality!

user_reviews.Name: Mariama White
user_reviews.Description: First time at ILEA Café yesterday and wow… loved it! The staff is super friendly, the place is clean, and they’ve got both indoor and outdoor seating. I went for lunch and it was so good I came back for dinner the same day. And this morning? I found myself back again for breakfast… I think I’m hooked on this place! The food is delicious with plenty of options for breakfast, brunch, or dinner, and the coffees + smoothies are next level. All of that for a very affordable menu. Truly a gem in Dakar — 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Roberta Liakaite
user_reviews.Description:
Super cute spot for breakfast or brunch. Friendly staff, and if you don't speak any French, there are people who do, so you will be fine!

Food is tasty and definitely make sure you try out their cookies!

user_reviews.Name: James Page
user_reviews.Description:
Just had the most amazing meal at Ilea Café and I’m still thinking about it!
The kebabs were absolutely perfect — juicy, well-seasoned, and grilled just right. Paired with the fried rice and colorful veggies, every bite was full of flavor and freshness.
Their carrot and beet juice was such a refreshing surprise — naturally sweet, vibrant, and super energizing.
And I couldn’t resist the chocolate chip cookie… soft, warm, and loaded with melty chocolate. The perfect sweet finish!
The whole place has this laid-back vibe with comfy seating, cool décor, and beautiful artwork on the walls that make it feel both cozy and creative. 🎨
If you’re ever in Dakar, make sure to stop by Ilea Café — it’s the perfect spot to unwind, eat great food, and soak in the atmosphere. 🌿☕️

user_reviews.Name: Juju B
user_reviews.Description: Gorgeous cafe, welcoming staff, and some of the best food I had in Dakar. Seriously, it’s a vibe and enjoyed a beautiful kora performance during one of the brunches. LOVE BAN

user_reviews.Name: Mariel Camargo
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing brunch spot!! I love their concept of a cafe + pottery workshop. I got the fried squid with yuzu sauce (amazing 😍), okra, and morning glory. Definitely recommend, the entire meal was really refreshing and nourishing. I also got the moringa cake with raspberry sorbet & wow- a definite must. It definitely looks as amazing as it tastes. I would hold off on the kombucha next t
Ike though, it wasn’t as carbonated as I expected it to be. They also have free wifi, so it is an amazing place to wfh or just work on any task. Something to keep in mind though is that the dining area is completely outside so it was kind of hot, but it’s well shaded so you aren’t under the sun. Amazing and attentive staff as well. This has been on of my favorite places to eat here in Dakar. 😍

user_reviews.Name: Patience
user_reviews.Description:
The drinks were good and the food had a beautiful presentation, however it was severely under seasoned.

Also, I received food poisoning, it could've been from all of the flies swarming the food.

user_reviews.Name: broucks wright
user_reviews.Description: Pottery workshop run by one sister while the other sister runs the restaurant. Imaginative food well conceived. Highly recommended.

user_reviews.Name: Tal Harris
user_reviews.Description: Wonderful fresh food and atmosphere, vegan options as well

user_reviews.Name: Jan-Paul Bruins
user_reviews.Description: Above and beyond expectations. Creative culinary experience blending traditional ingredients into modern dishes. Not pretentious, just great food and service.

user_reviews.Name: Fabian Heppe
user_reviews.Description: In a bustling city like Dakar, where traffic is heavy and noise is omnipresent, Ban Café stands out as an oasis for those seeking respite. It's a place I always find myself returning to, offering not just good food but also a serene ambiance where one can unwind, engage in friendly conversations with the staff, and rejuvenate. Nestled amidst passion fruit plants, visitors can indulge in delicious, wholesome meals and savor quality coffee at fairly reasonable prices. What sets Ban Café apart is the evident passion and care put into its construction, reflecting in every detail. The staff exudes warmth and hospitality, always willing to engage in a friendly chat. Without a doubt, it's one of my favorite spots in Dakar.

user_reviews.Name: John Hansen
user_reviews.Description: Been here a couple of times because the menu is amazing and absolutely original. The place is also beautiful and relaxed, you can even sit and work and enjoy their good coffee. Even the waitresses are fantastic, so just a wonderful experience.

title: L'Adresse Dakar
description: Colourful rooms & suites in a chic hotel with an outdoor pool, a rooftop bar & a stylish restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Brian Johnson
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely loved this hotel. The location in Almadies is perfect, and the building itself is beautiful — high ceilings, airy spaces, and a relaxed coastal feel.

The staff are exceptional, especially Anissa, who truly went above and beyond to help me arrange a driver to St. Louis and onward to The Gambia. That kind of personal care makes all the difference.

There’s a great rooftop bar, balconies in the rooms, and at night you can hear the ocean — which is pretty magical.

They even have a cat named Croissant, who I want to take with me. If you’re concerned about allergies, don’t be — the space is large and well-ventilated, so it’s not an issue.

Hard to ask for more from a hotel. I’d absolutely stay here again.

user_reviews.Name: timtraveler14
user_reviews.Description: I really loved my stay at L’Adresse.  The entire staff was so friendly.  Especially Thierry, the excellent server at the rooftop restaurant.  That restaurant was so nice, you can sit in the sun and look out over the ocean.  The airport shuttle was very nice.  And the hotel is close to a mosque and the Embassy of Guinea for onward travel.  The hotel is great!

user_reviews.Name: Matias Almang
user_reviews.Description:
I loved my stay at L’Adresse. The staff are very friendly and accommodating. They really make a great effort for your stay to be pleasant.

Even with my basic French, they were very patient and understanding. And they also spoke English.

The hotel has a nice rooftop bar, beautiful to enjoy the sunsets. The downstairs bar also offers nice drinks. The food is delicious!

The location is good, close to nice restaurants.

Thanks very much!

user_reviews.Name: lucifer796
user_reviews.Description: I want to say special thanks to Anissa J.M Seck who works reception. She is super professional, friendly, kind and understanding. She deserves a raise in salary. Other than that, personnel is friendly and professional. Why i can’t give the 5 stars is because personnel working the restaurant is completely clueless what infredients are in the food, which can cause fatal accidents if person is allergic to seafood etc. Because we had an instance where my companion ordered vegetarian food yet they brought seafood option and waiter argued that it’s vegetables and went twice to the kitchen to ask the chef where chef just confirmed its vegetarian option. After some arguing, the waiter agreed to take the food to the kitchen and informed that the correct order is coming (not admitting the mistake). Next time it happend on next day during breakfast when me companion asked if spring rolls contain meat to which waiter said no, that its vegetarian, which was also completely false. So get that together please. Rooms are spacious and clean. Cleaning staff do the great job upkeep the place in cleanliness. There is parking outside the hotel with 24/7 security. Overall great place, but just educate staff and kitchen to take orders and allergens seriously.

user_reviews.Name: Vanessa Cheris
user_reviews.Description:
THE GOOD
Room was spacious. It’s a newly built hotel so everything is clean and relatively modern, albeit simple

The Senegalese food at the rooftop bar was fantastic. The tieb rice was on point and fish, wonderful. We also had the beef skewers and plantains but get the traditional meals. The waiter didn’t understand our order and gave us double the amount of meals we asked for instead of a side, so they over-charged but it tasted great, and it was nice ambiance up there.

THE BAD
The room is missing basic amenities - towels! We had 2 ppl in the room and they refused to bring us enough towels. I called  and went down to reception twice and they still did nothing. No wash cloths, No lotion. They charge close to Pullman prices, but have significantly less amenities

Hotel is solid but should cost closer to 150 USD for what you get, not over 200 USD

user_reviews.Name: Worldwide Reviewer
user_reviews.Description:
I rarely write negative reviews, but my experience at L’dresse Hotel was frustrating enough to warrant one.

Unhelpful staff: The reception staff showed little interest in improving our stay. For two days we were promised that our room change would happen “tomorrow,” yet nothing was done until we insisted repeatedly.

Basic amenities neglected: We had to ask daily for toilet paper and water bottles because room service failed to provide them. For half of our 8‑night stay, we lived with only one towel set, and our requests for additional towels were ignored.

Cockroach problem: Our first room (404) had six cockroaches the moment we opened the door. After moving to room 210, we still encountered three more over the next six days.

Poor room conditions: Rooms smelled of mold and moisture, showers were rusty, and noise isolation was terrible.

Breakfast disappointment: The food selection was minimal and of low quality, far below expectations for a hotel stay.

Confusing hotel name: Even getting to the hotel was a struggle. The name “L’dresse” confused many French‑speaking taxi drivers, and we had to explain the address multiple times before being understood.

Individually, these issues might be tolerable, but combined they created an environment that was uncomfortable and unsuitable for a business trip—especially a longer one. L’dresse Hotel failed to provide even the basics of hospitality, and I cannot recommend it.

user_reviews.Description: I had brunch at Jet Cafe and it was delicious, with a great variety of food. The place is very clean, the staff are nice, well dressed, and well mannered. The view was amazing as well. I would definitely recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Tariro Mlanda
user_reviews.Description: Breathtaking atmosphere in white and fairy lights along the beach. What more can one want. The views are spectacular especially in the evening. Great service.  The food is very tasty and the portions are huge. However if you are not a fan of garlic, you might not enjoy the fish here for garlic is one of the main ingredients of their fish dishes. The atmosphere is still worth the visit though...

user_reviews.Name: Alex Adeiza
user_reviews.Description:
Jet Cafe Beach marked the very first outing of my 2-day stay in Dakar, Senegal. We went as a family and this place was just on point for us to neutralize the cold, eat and either watch the sun kiss the sea, or feets ride the ski.
The food was awesome - let’s keep it at that.
The service is where I had a bit of a problem because of language barrier. I had a bit of French to go by, but no staff could speak as much English as I did French. Well, Google translator helped a bit much.
The atmosphere was good. Light music, beautiful view, great white ambience with a glow of love all around to give that perfect picturesque. Nice nice 😊

user_reviews.Name: Hannah P
user_reviews.Description:
A beautiful restaurant overlooking the Atlantic Ocean! It was breezy, clean, and the staff were very friendly.

The menu is just a bit pricey, but understandable because the location and service were amazing! Would definitely recommend. :)

user_reviews.Name: Adam in Africa
user_reviews.Description: I had a nice dinner here: Fresh fish, with vegetables, rice, and a side salad, and a nice crepe with ice-cream for dessert. The service is great, you are right on the beach, and the restaurant has a nice atmosphere.

user_reviews.Name: Yeesh Rose
user_reviews.Description: Amazing views and great customer service. However food quality could have been better and the food could be hotter in temperature. The plantain was divine and freshly made though, yuummm!!

user_reviews.Name: Gueye Cissé
user_reviews.Description: I had the best time at Fly Trap Cafe attending a basket weaving class. The food was amazing - the summer rolls and the shrimp sandwiches are 10/10. Great if you are looking for a community or just looking for a nice coworking space also. I definitely recommend !

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Mbock
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve visited this café twice for special events (a weaving workshop and a Thanksgiving dinner), and each time was genuinely wonderful. From the staff to the hosts and the other guests, everyone is incredibly warm and welcoming. The décor and layout make the place feel truly “comme à la maison,” which creates such a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The food and drinks are great as well — special shout-out to their homemade tea, which has become my favorite. And I have to mention the playlist too… it really adds to the whole vibe.
It’s also a great place if you’re looking for a calm and comfortable environment to work remotely. And if you’re around when they host events, I highly recommend joining — it’s a fantastic opportunity to meet lovely people.

user_reviews.Description: I am just visiting from New York and was very pleased to find this gem.   I was so impressed with the ambience and the service. I was able to get fresh-pressed juice, which is hard to find in Dakar.  Will make this my go-to spot when visiting!

user_reviews.Description:
Best brunch spot in Dakar with a panoramic sea view!

What I loved the most is that there was no background music, so you can really enjoy the sound of the sea and have a nice conversation with your best friend.

The menu is very interesting, with several vegan options.
The prices are high, but they’re worth it for both the quantity and the quality.

I tried the Kebab Fusion. It was delicious and really big. I actually felt full after eating only half 😂. But the quatity of the french fries was very small.

I also had a vanilla latte, but it was a bit disappointing. I didn’t really taste the vanilla. It just felt like a regular latte.

The Regina pizza is also very tasty.

I’m definitely going back to try more dishes.

It’s hard to find a nice place in Dakar with a beautiful sea view and good food, and for me, Elena Café is the best for all three. Many places on the Petite Corniche downtown are quite expensive, but Elena Café feels really worth it.

We came back to this place after we tried their Margarita Panini sandwich! Oh my god! Amazing food

Great service! Very sweet staff. :)

They also recommended the Italian dessert - Cannoli. We tried the pistachio one. Amazing dessert! ❤️

I felt the price of paninis is very good.

user_reviews.Description: Lovely coffee place. Amazing and delicious panini. Coffee is bitter and lovely. The best seat is near the window - best way to enjoy a great brunch or coffee, and watch people walking past the narrow street. Additional bonus for them is for supporting Ukraine - thank you!

user_reviews.Name: ItsArantxa
user_reviews.Description: I usually have very good service. I come here very often before work. Today unfortunately had a very bad experience. I enter the shop and there was a customer before me so I wait my turn, there comes someone behind me and he got attended before me. I was a bit confused, so I ask if I could please order. The worker says that her colleague would help me and then she proceeded to help the costumers after me that went After me into the shop. I simply just got ingored and skipped not once but twice. I hope you can tell your employees not to prioritize bigger groups because everyone is a customer. I’m very very disappointed. ( this happened on 29th of dec at 9:50 ish)

user_reviews.Description: I wanted to have a good sandwich and I had a delicious one

user_reviews.Name: Aleksandra Wolska
user_reviews.Description: I’m so happy I found this bakery! The country loaf is the best bread I had in amsterdam. It is located in a pretty and quiet neighborhood with a little terrace outside - perfect for some coffee and pastries. From the pastries I highly recommend the apple ans blueberry scone - a nice combination between traditional scone and sourdough bread. It is just a pity they don’t slice the bread.

user_reviews.Name: Laura CC
user_reviews.Description:
Really really good bakery.
The bread is exceptional. Great flavour and texture. Lekker.
The croissant of ham and cheese, amazing. The puff pastry was very well made, crispy.
Te pistachio bun, very delicious. I thought it would be very sweet, but no, it had an exact point of sweetness and I loved it.
The flat white small portion but good.
Added to my trusted sites.

user_reviews.Name: Susana Casas
user_reviews.Description: They have the only croissant in town that makes me close my eyes and think of Paris. Their breads are well fermented and have that sour tang that i enjoy so much in sourdough. Have not tried a lot but so far very pleased. Coffee could be a bit stronger thou. But i'll forgive anything if the croissant is outstanding, like that of Millie's ! Happy customer :)

user_reviews.Name: Yishyan Amanda
user_reviews.Description: It’s a gorgeous bakery and great selection, but the customer service was lacking . The sourdough was great, the almond croissant barely had any filling so that was disappointing but the croissant itself was flaky and buttery. I just was expecting more almond filling inside

user_reviews.Name: mies
user_reviews.Description:
I absolutely love the pastries from this bakery! We had the one with pistachio and the one with cinnamon and they were so tasty! All their products are baked with sourdough and organic ingredients, amazing! I usually get quiet bloated when I eat pastries with gluten, but not after eating their goods :)
The place is also very aesthetic and calming, which is always a huge bonus for me. The coffee and latte’s also taste good, the only thing I would recommend is to maybe get some more options for vegan milk, like from the brand Rude Health for example (without any gums or seed oils) 🙏🏼 They also don’t serve matcha, which is quiet surprising these days for places like this. But that’s all just personal preference :)

user_reviews.Name: Ksenia Troshchenkova
user_reviews.Description: I am coming here quite often for great coffee, freshly baked goods and a nice chat. The coffee beans are from small Dutch roasters and the coffee is always tasty here. Different kinds of bread and pastries are always fresh and baked just in front of you. Everyone who works here is very welcoming and the interior is very stylish! It’s amazing to have such a cozy place around!

user_reviews.Name: Paul van den Berg
user_reviews.Description:
February 2025
Of course we need good bakers in this part of Amsterdam. And it's busy in the weekends and with a reason. Love their products, especially the ham-cheese croissants they are perfect, the croissant dough is what you expect in France. And yes the Cinnamon (Kardemom) buns are good as well.

Their coffee could use a punch and might be a bit stronger, in cappuccino the milk is what you tast. Otherwise it would all be 5 star ....

user_reviews.Name: Manuel Almeida
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely loved this bakery! The first thing that hit me was the smell. Honestly, it was impossible not to smile. The place is really cute and decorated with so much care that you can tell they put love into it. The lady who helped me was genuinely lovely, super warm and friendly, which just made everything feel even better. I left with great pastries and an even better mood. 100% worth a visit :D

user_reviews.Name: efrem. m
user_reviews.Description:
This place is amazing and the reviews in this case definitely prove it. Cozy atmosphere, good aesthetics, amazing variety of both savory and sweet pastries.

I visited this place twice in 3 days. Every pastry I tried was excellent, but the most memorable would be the spicy mango papillon. Amazing natural mango flavor with a decent amount of spice, and of course super flaky and buttery. The mushroom quiche was also super good.

user_reviews.Name: Nivaan Pather
user_reviews.Description: So so good! One of the (if not the) best cheese and tomato sandwiches. Served by the owners. Really nice couple. The pasties were so good. Really happy we stopped by. If we lived in Amsterdam, this would definitely be our local got to spot!

user_reviews.Name: Laura Eva Menendez
user_reviews.Description:
I still remember the chocolate and pecan praline cream habano and I would go back to Amsterdam just to have it again! So delicious, my God! Even though the size looks like it would be huge, it’s not. It’s super airy and the cream is light, so you can really taste all the flavors—the dough, the crunch, the chocolate, and the cream.
We also ordered the croissant and the cinnamon bun, which never disappoint! Definitely some of the best we’ve had in Amsterdam

user_reviews.Name: Ömer Durkut
user_reviews.Description:
I had the regulair crossaint and the chocolate & pecan praline cream habanos  crossaint.

The regulair crossaint didn't feel like it was made with butter, i'm not actually sure if its a vegan baker, even having said that the crossaint was quite dry and chewy. And likewise no buttery taste. The airyness and honeycomb like strucrute was there though.

The habanos, texture was good, easy to eat. The chocolate bar which was inside didn't really taste it. The pecan praline cream was not spread evenly throughout and it wasn't a very thick cream, more like a bit runny and not a strong flavor. Had higher expectations.

The people who were working there were quite nice.

user_reviews.Name: begüm m
user_reviews.Description: I tried the cinnamon roll, spinach and feta pastry, pain au chocolat, kimchi croissant, and salted caramel cruffin. The cruffin was my absolute favorite, followed by the cinnamon roll. The cappuccino was excellent, and the prices were reasonable. This place truly deserves its high rating.

user_reviews.Name: sh lim
user_reviews.Description: Nice cozy bakery. Have been there for several years and they are super friendly. The taste of bread is much better than usual bakeries nearby

user_reviews.Name: Henry
user_reviews.Description: A hidden gem tucked behind the Albert Cuyp Market stalls—this artisanal sourdough bakery is absolutely worth seeking out. The bread has real depth of flavor, and the viennoiserie is beautifully flaky, buttery, and made with obvious care. A calm, delicious escape from the market buzz.

user_reviews.Name: toms van miller
user_reviews.Description: A lovely neighborhood bakery in De Pijp with that warm, cozy vibe you hope for. The croissants are excellent—fresh, crisp, and buttery—and the staff are super kind and welcoming. An easy place to become a regular.

user_reviews.Name: Emma Lacey
user_reviews.Description: The Baking Lab in Amsterdam is an absolutely lovely shop! Fortunately, or perhaps unfortunately for my waist, my hotel happened to be just a block away from this lovely little bakery, so obviously I stopped by on three out of the four days I spent in the city. The pastries are delightfully soft and flaky, with a melt on your tongue consistency that only comes from a superb bake. The coffee is flavorful, tasty, and the perfect companion to anything you choose from the counter. The entire shop feels warm and welcoming, a perfect place to perch with a book or catch up with friends on a cold winter day ☺️ I could not have asked for a sweeter neighborhood spot during my stay.

user_reviews.Name: Cendy H
user_reviews.Description:
We visited in a cold early winter morning (Dec 2025), the gloomy environment changed the instant we came in.
The place was warm and smelled of fresh baked croissants mixed with sourdough.

Don’t miss this place whenever you are in Amsterdam. Get in at 8am and enjoy the vibe.

user_reviews.Name: shravya
user_reviews.Description: A charming spot for coffee! I visited on a sunny Sunday around 3 PM, and it was pleasantly quiet. The terrace is lovely, perfect for people-watching. The staff were friendly, and we tried the recommended Famous Framboos and the unique croissant cake. The fresh carrot juice was especially refreshing. I’ll definitely be back.

user_reviews.Name: Jérémie Gobeil
user_reviews.Description: Great bread and tasty pastries served by friendly people. A cosy place to take a coffee or even your sourdough starter.

user_reviews.Name: Samet Sakik
user_reviews.Description: We ordered 2 plain croissants and 2 flat whites with oat milk. The croissants were really fresh and coffees were really delicious. I would like to thank especially the barista lady. She was very kindly and friendly.

user_reviews.Name: Tanya Mahajan
user_reviews.Description: great coffee & selection on breakfast items! nice quaint cafe where you can buy really nice sourdough bread & also learn how to make one! can buy flour for sourdough bread too!

user_reviews.Name: Ruby Sands
user_reviews.Description: Super cute bakery with amazing bread, pastries and hot drinks! a new favourite

user_reviews.Name: Tamara Sears
user_reviews.Description: We took a class and LOVED it! The hardworking team made us feel very welcome. Their passion for creating wonderful baked goods is noticed in every detail. It’s great to see that it’s not lost in younger generations. Keep up the fabulous work knowing that it brings joy and love to those who share your foods.
